original_text:
I had a very disappointing experience with Myntra and would genuinely recommend being careful before ordering from this app. I ordered a night suit around 4–5 August. When I received it, I was extremely disappointed with the quality. The fabric was very thin, uncomfortable, and felt irritating on the skin. The product was not at all as expected.
I immediately tried to initiate a return, but I was told that the product could not be returned because it was marked as a “cash”/non-returnable item. I don’t understand this policy because I had already paid the full amount for the order.
What made the experience even worse was the repeated change in the return timeline. Initially, I was told the return would be processed by 15 August, then it was changed to 20 August, and now it has been delayed again until 28 August.

This has been a very frustrating experience, especially when the product quality itself was so poor.
My personal experience with Myntra has been extremely disappointing. Please check the return policy and product details carefully before ordering. I personally would prefer other platforms like Amazon or Meesho for clothing purchases after this experience.
Very poor experience. Disappointed with the product quality and return service.
purchase_barrier: product marked as non‑returnable and delayed return processing
user_need: clear return policy and reliable product quality
observed_evidence: The user ordered a night suit on 4–5 August and received a product described as thin, uncomfortable, and irritating, which did not meet expectations. They attempted to return the item but were told it could not be returned because it was marked as a “cash”/non‑returnable item, despite having paid the full amount. The return processing timeline was repeatedly changed from 15 August to 20 August and then to 28 August, causing further frustration. The user expressed a strong preference for other platforms and described the overall experience as very poor.
ai_inference: The user’s frustration stems from a perceived conflict between the product’s poor quality and the inability to return it, compounded by inconsistent communication about the return timeline. The user feels that the return policy is unfair or unclear and that the service is unreliable.
root_cause_hypothesis: Likely the product was incorrectly flagged as non‑returnable in the system, leading to the return denial, and the return processing delays may be due to system or staffing constraints. This mislabeling and inconsistent timeline communication may be causing the user’s negative experience.
